```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
```

```{r}
csv_path <- "csv_files"

seasonal_data <- read_csv(file.path(csv_path, "Seasonal_summary.csv"))
metadata <- read_csv(file.path(csv_path, "Metadata.csv"))
```

```{r}
#tidy and add yearly totals 
seasonal_tidy <- seasonal_data |>
  rename(park_name = `Park name`) |>
  mutate(
    season = str_extract(Season, "^[A-Za-z]+"),
    year = as.numeric(str_extract(Season, "\\d{4}$")),
    vehicle_visits = `Vehicle visits`
  ) |>
  group_by(park_name, year) |>
  mutate(yearly_total = sum(vehicle_visits, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
#tidy metadata
metadata_tidy <- metadata |>
  rename(park_name = `Park name`,
         unit_type = `Unit type`,
         park_system = `Park system`)
```

```{r}
#join for map-ready data
map_ready_data <- seasonal_tidy |>
  left_join(metadata_tidy, by = "park_name")
```

```{r}
#save
write_csv(map_ready_data, file.path(csv_path, "map_ready_data.csv"))
```
